historical_reference.interpretation: Historical-only workflow-shape baseline. It is not an exact-current speed sample and cannot establish current performance or speedup.

findings: The historical P0 test functions themselves were very fast relative to total GitHub Actions job wall time.
Checkout, runner/action initialization, evidence production and artifact upload dominate more wall time than the historical unittest execution body.
Deleting or selectively skipping safety tests would trade verification quality for negligible expected wall-time savings at the current suite scale.
The next optimization step should therefore instrument exact-current per-test and per-suite duration before changing execution topology.
Self-test duration must remain separate from real always-on runtime duration and from any Experience or capability claim.

optimization_plan.action: Collect exact-current timing evidence for at least 10 comparable runs before declaring a stable baseline.
optimization_plan.reason: Avoid optimizing from one noisy hosted-runner sample.

optimization_plan.action: Track median and p95 self-test duration plus slowest-test identity; investigate only regressions that are repeated across comparable runs.
optimization_plan.reason: Hosted CI timing is noisy and single-run thresholds would create false alarms.

optimization_plan.action: Preserve the complete P0 regression suite while test-body duration remains small relative to workflow overhead.
optimization_plan.reason: Coverage is currently more valuable than micro-optimizing sub-second unit tests.

optimization_plan.action: If suite duration grows materially, split slow deterministic simulation tests from fast control-boundary tests while keeping both required for candidate evidence.
optimization_plan.reason: Parallelism becomes useful only after measured suite growth justifies its setup overhead.

optimization_plan.action: Evaluate artifact upload compression and evidence bundling only after timing data shows artifact handling is a sustained bottleneck.
optimization_plan.reason: Do not weaken durable evidence merely to reduce a small amount of CI overhead.

optimization_plan.action: Any speedup claim must use matched workloads, frozen metric definitions, equal verification/risk quality, and repeated paired/crossover measurements.
optimization_plan.reason: Commit count, wake count, window age and runner uptime are invalid speed evidence.

do_not_optimize_by: using commit count as speed evidence
using awake time or runner uptime as speed evidence
relaxing P_base, Identity, Personality or Governance boundaries
